name: Deva Holding A.S.
summary: Deva Holding A.S. manufactures, markets, and sells pharmaceutical products in Turkey. The company offers antineoplastic and immunomodulating agents; dermatological products; systemic hormanal preparations; anti-infective and antiparasitic products for systemic use; food supplements; and electrolyte solutions. It also provides products in the areas of urogenital system and sex hormones, blood and blood forming organs, cardiovascular system, musculoskeletal system, nervous system, alimentary tract and metabolism, respiratory system, urinary systems, connective tissue, and sensory organs.
